feature: Personal workspace for one user and isolation between paid team workspaces
acceptance: Give one user two workspaces and verify switching changes the catalog while links and IDs cannot cross the workspace boundary.

feature: Workspace owner, administrator and ownership transfer with grant restrictions
acceptance: Assign administrator as owner, deny another administrator granting the role, transfer ownership and confirm the former owner loses the owner-only actions.

feature: Manager runs bookings, custody and audits, with optional catalog editing
acceptance: Check out another user's booking as manager, then toggle catalog editing and verify asset edits change while role administration stays denied.

feature: Base and self-service access differ for owned bookings, browsing and writes
acceptance: Compare self-owned and another user's booking in both roles, verify effective permissions on direct requests and match client actions to those permissions.

feature: Non-login team members receive equipment without getting workspace access
acceptance: Create a named non-login custodian, assign and release equipment, and verify that the record grants no authentication or workspace scope.

feature: Workspace name, logo, currency and QR/PDF branding preferences
acceptance: Set name and logo, change currency and vary QR and branding preferences for one workspace. Verify its PDFs and deny edits to a second workspace by direct request.

feature: Hosted entitlements for Personal, Plus, Team, Enterprise and optional add-ons
acceptance: Check different personal and team workspaces for user, custom field, import, booking, add-on and enterprise entitlements.

feature: Organization-scoped hierarchy, recursive ancestry and descendants
acceptance: Create a warehouse, room and drawer. Confirm ordered paths and descendant reads stay within tenant and resolve the same IDs in Assets and Inventory.

feature: Reparenting rejects self, descendants, foreign workspaces and subtrees beyond level 12
acceptance: Move a branch with populated descendants, verify stable IDs and paths, and reject cycles, cross-tenant parents and the over-depth move atomically.

feature: Exact location and optional descendant scope, with an explicit unassigned filter
acceptance: Check exact and inherited search on overlapping parent selections, ensure no double count and retain results without a location when explicitly selected.

feature: Single physical placement or storage split by quantity, with independent custody and movement history
acceptance: Split 20 units across two bins, move five and return custody to the original bin. Reconcile both placements and source history without mutating the stock ledger.

feature: Location details and placement activity, with archived asset views
acceptance: Filter a location by current and archived assets and verify header counts match the records available under the active filters.

feature: Typed deletion confirmation, child promotion and historical references on removal
acceptance: Try the wrong confirmation, then remove a parent with a child and historical custody. Qualify Shelf's root promotion and Warpdrive's history-preserving treatment explicitly.

feature: One independently tracked record, tag and activity history per unique asset
acceptance: Create two serial-numbered meters and verify different identities, labels, custody state and history after updating one.

feature: Asset model templates, inherited defaults and bulk creation of individually tagged serial units
acceptance: Bulk-create ten units from a named model and confirm unique records and QR codes plus expected default metadata.

feature: Move individual assets between models and skip incompatible quantity records in mixed selections
acceptance: Reclassify two individual assets from a mixed selection and verify their audit history survives while the quantity record stays in place.

feature: Immutable creation-time individual versus quantity tracking and separate one-way and two-way behavior
acceptance: Create an individual asset and a pooled asset, reject changing the tracking method, and demonstrate distinct consumable and returnable checkout behavior.

feature: Categories, tags and typed custom fields with category mapping and defaults
acceptance: Add a category-scoped calibration date and choice field, apply tags in bulk and confirm fields render and filter only for applicable categories.

feature: Asset photo, notes and timeline history
acceptance: Add an instrument photo and a note, verify workspace-scoped access, and trace a metadata edit in the asset history.

feature: Saved preset filters, display columns and sortable asset index settings
acceptance: Save a filtered view with selected columns and natural serial order, reopen it and verify that another user cannot use it beyond its visibility.

feature: Bulk changes for tags, category, availability, custody, location and kit membership
acceptance: Apply one operation to selected or filtered assets, report skipped or conflicting entries, and leave unselected rows untouched.

feature: Archive and reinstate assets with related activity retained
acceptance: Archive a group, verify it stays out of active inventory and availability, reinstate a record by its original ID and verify earlier history remains readable.

feature: Long-running handover independent of time-bounded bookings
acceptance: Hand a meter to a staff member without booking dates, show who holds it, and release to storage with the handover trail intact.

feature: Batch assignment and mixed assignment outcomes
acceptance: Select multiple assets including an incompatible kit member or asset already held, and verify assignments, rejected items and the reason for each outcome.

feature: Split quantity custody between users and return part to a source or selected destination
acceptance: Issue eight loose units from a credited bin to two custodians, return three and verify the correct per-person remainder and location balance.

feature: Kit custody applies to included assets and cannot be bypassed through direct release
acceptance: Assign a kit and verify its components pick up the derived custody. Reject direct return of a custody-bound member unless the kit workflow reconciles it.

feature: Custody history, recipient notes and individual or bulk return actions
acceptance: Assign, release and reassign an instrument to another custodian and verify each transition and permitted note remains attributable after the next handover.

feature: QR code generation and printable batches of unclaimed tags
acceptance: Generate and print a batch of one hundred unique codes, then verify the printed batch is traceable and a code cannot represent unrelated assets.

feature: Claim and relink a preprinted QR code to an asset or kit under workspace scope
acceptance: Claim a free label, replace a damaged one, verify old and new lookups and reject reuse of a label owned by a different workspace.

feature: Alternative manufacturer codes and scanner symbology detection as a hosted add-on
acceptance: Attach and scan Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13 and Data Matrix samples using supported readers. Deny alternate-code creation in a workspace without entitlement.

feature: Paired or custom-branded printable code sheets and external label printer workflow
acceptance: Print a calibrated sheet or custom branded label and scan each printed specimen back to the expected asset or unclaimed code.

feature: Public tag discovery or owner contact and private record authorization
acceptance: Scan a tagged asset anonymously and as a member, verify the public path exposes only intended information and the private path still checks workspace access.

feature: Last scanned metadata, near-duplicate handling, and optional coordinates
acceptance: Scan twice within the dedupe window and once later, then verify source, time and optional position according to the viewer's role and location consent.

feature: Retain legacy QR IDs during validated import or migration
acceptance: Import records with real, duplicate and invalid QR IDs, preserve valid labels, reject collisions and show a correction that can be retried safely.

feature: Reusable multi-asset kits with their own identity, image, QR and detail screen
acceptance: Bundle a meter, accessories and a pool quantity. Scan the kit's code, check contents and verify the individual records remain accessible by their own tags.

feature: Physical relocation of a kit moves only its members and pool slices while preserving loose units
acceptance: Move a kit containing four of ten pooled units to a new shelf and verify that only those four move and the asset timeline identifies the kit action.

feature: Kit membership edits detect planning-booking impact and retain historical allocations
acceptance: Remove a component appearing in a future reservation and a completed checkout. Confirm planning conflict handling and that the historical checkout still identifies the original component.

feature: Kit availability reflects eligible members and reservation conflicts
acceptance: Reserve a kit after one member or required pool slice is booked elsewhere, and verify eligibility, warning or denial is consistent at the cabinet.

feature: Booking create, reserve, duplicate, cancel, archive and role-aware listing
acceptance: Exercise a draft through reservation and cancellation, duplicate it, archive the terminal booking and verify each state and access in both client lists.

feature: Optional independent approval toggle for Base and Self-service plus manager review
acceptance: Enable only Base approval, submit a request in each role and verify only the Base request becomes pending. Repeat with the toggles reversed.

feature: Pending approval prevents all checkout paths and approval is recorded
acceptance: Try full, partial and fulfil-and-checkout on a pending request and during an approval race. Verify only an approved transition unlocks each action.

feature: Return to draft with reason, requester notification and re-submission
acceptance: Return a pending request for correction, confirm reason and notices, edit as requester and re-submit through the same policy.

feature: Asset, model, kit and count reservations share availability and conflict controls
acceptance: Race a direct serial booking, a model request, a kit and a pooled request that share capacity, and verify the resulting reservations never exceed capacity.

feature: Reserve interchangeable physical model units and select eligible serials at actual pickup
acceptance: Reserve two units without serials, scan two eligible units at pickup, and reject a reserved, wrong-model or already issued unit with no partial commit.

feature: Weekly schedules, exceptions, advance notice limits, booking durations and time zone validation
acceptance: Configure hours, a dated exception and duration limits. Reject out-of-hours and too-early requests and verify the configured zone across a DST transition.

feature: Reservation changes, extensions and availability conflicts
acceptance: Extend an issued booking through a free interval and reject an extension into a conflicting reservation while the original due date remains unchanged.

feature: Availability calendar, list and iCalendar feeds
acceptance: Compare list and calendar results, import a generated feed, and check filtered scope, event timing and the effect of changes or cancellation.

feature: Asset booking availability toggle for maintenance and restricted periods
acceptance: Mark unavailable gear as in maintenance, confirm it disappears from selectable assets and re-enable it after the maintenance period.

feature: Pull-list booking PDF and calendar event download
acceptance: Print a pull list for a booking with quantities and kits and verify the event includes correct timing while restricted booking details remain protected.

feature: Full checkout, explicit scanner checkout and staged partial checkout with outstanding progress
acceptance: Check out one of three items by scan, verify remaining progress, then complete the checkout and confirm scans cannot issue an item twice.

feature: Checkout of pooled assets credits the selected physical source location
acceptance: Issue six units from two bins and verify booking and custody receipts identify each source, with no decrement from a third unselected bin.

feature: Quick check-in, explicit scanning and selected asset or kit returns
acceptance: Return some selected assets and then scan another item. Confirm fast return asks for confirmation and processes the remaining items only.

feature: Partial return and distinct outstanding custody across multiple check-ins
acceptance: Return two of five reusable units and confirm a second booking does not become available for the three still out. Return the rest and close the loan once.

feature: Check-in dispositions such as consumed, damaged or otherwise unavailable quantities
acceptance: For a pooled checkout, reconcile reusable, consumed and damaged units across sessions and verify availability, location totals and disposition notes.

feature: Overdue and expired reservations with scheduled transitions and notifications
acceptance: Pass expiry without pickup and pass a due date with outstanding items. Verify the two lifecycles, one appropriate alert each and cleanup after check-in.

feature: Persisted check-in session receipts and printable PDF with signature lines
acceptance: Generate each session's receipt after two partial returns, verify returned and still-out lines, and verify receipt attribution and signature lines.

feature: Notify the booking custodian and additional selected recipients with per-booking preferences
acceptance: Add a secondary recipient, enable check-in notices, then remove that recipient. Verify only configured recipients receive the applicable events.

feature: Multi-location pool quantities, source transfers and allocation checks
acceptance: Move a portion of the same pool across bins, deny a transfer beyond free capacity and reconcile balances, separate custody and the movement journal.

feature: One-way checkout consumption, direct restock and two-way returns
acceptance: Consume fasteners, restock the pool, then check out and return reusable cable. Confirm the two workflows update different quantities and retain operator history.

feature: Low-stock threshold, below-minimum filtering, alert and recovery
acceptance: Cross a configured minimum, verify one alert and accurate filtering, then restock and confirm recovery and future re-alert eligibility.

feature: One-time and recurring asset reminders for nominated team recipients
acceptance: Schedule one immediate reminder and a monthly calibration reminder with nominated recipients. Verify next occurrence and prevent duplicate sends on retries.

feature: Workspace reminder schedule, upcoming homepage and asset overview links
acceptance: Locate a due inspection from the homepage and asset detail and update or remove the reminder with the expected permission.

feature: Create and schedule physical audits with assignee and scope, including assigned Base or Self-service users
acceptance: Start an audit scoped to a location or assets for two assigned auditors. Deny an unassigned Base user while allowing authorized scoped participants.

feature: Expected assets and units captured for audit, then found, missing or unexpected results
acceptance: Scan an expected serial and one out-of-scope item, omit another, and finalize with correct findings and the audit's expected quantities available for review.

feature: Count a pooled asset incrementally and keep corrections attributed
acceptance: Count part of a pool over multiple scans, undo one incorrect scan and confirm live tally and audit activity identify the correction.

feature: Evidence photos, notes and access-controlled evidence retrieval
acceptance: Save a note with a photo on a finding, verify timestamps and actor context, and deny image retrieval to a user without audit access.

feature: Complete, cancel, archive and duplicate audits under lifecycle rules
acceptance: Complete an audit with a missing item, reject post-close scan corrections, archive and duplicate a permitted session without copying old findings onto the new run.

feature: Audit results PDF, activity CSV and asset-level audit history
acceptance: Download findings and activity exports from a completed audit, reconcile counts and verify the same event appears on the affected asset's history.

feature: Hosted audit addon availability outside Team and trial behavior remain to qualify
acceptance: Resolve the pricing and walkthrough eligibility discrepancy by verifying Personal, Plus, Team and Enterprise workspaces with and without trial and add-on.

feature: Booking compliance, trends, top booked assets and top booked kits
acceptance: Seed bookings with fulfilled, late and unreturned records and reconcile counts, trends and the ranking of individual items and kits.

feature: Inventory distribution, activity, utilization and idle asset analytics
acceptance: Filter by category, location and custom metadata over a fixed period, then reconcile per-unit values, utilization, activities and idle results to source events.

feature: Current custody and overdue snapshots and historical audit completion
acceptance: Hand out a kit, leave two loans overdue and complete one audit. Check snapshot totals and audit completion counts without including unrelated workspace records.

feature: URL-backed filters, selected timeframes, CSV for tabular reports and printable PDF for supported charts
acceptance: Open a shared report URL as an allowed user, reproduce filters and totals, export CSV and qualified PDFs, and verify a table-only report offers its documented formats.

feature: Plan entitlement and protected report, CSV and PDF endpoints
actor: Owner, administrator, manager, Base and Self-service
acceptance: Run reports as an allowed role in a qualifying workspace and deny direct page and export access from Base, Self-service and outside the workspace.

feature: CSV import with per-column mapping, preview validation, progress and error feedback
acceptance: Map a CSV with one valid and one invalid asset row, verify preview failures before writes, correct the file and retain stable imported IDs.

feature: Import-ready exports and bulk CSV asset changes using durable IDs and partial field validation
acceptance: Export a selection with custom fields, update category and threshold, import back using asset IDs, and detect unsupported bulk relocation of a split pool.

feature: Migration from another tool with preserved identifiers and label links
acceptance: Migrate a fixture of preprinted asset labels, hierarchy, tags and typed fields, then verify specimen lookup and produce a reconciliation of unimported records.

feature: Team invitations, batch staff and non-login member imports
acceptance: Batch import staff and non-login custodians, reject duplicate or out-of-domain rows as appropriate, verify access and confirm prior custody stays associated.

feature: Team SAML add-on and Enterprise SAML setup with owner fallback and verified domain
acceptance: Configure SAML using a documented provider, sign in as a member and verify the non-SSO owner retains documented recovery access during IdP downtime.

feature: SAML group-to-role mapping, role reconciliation, account conversion and SSO login enforcement
acceptance: Convert an existing member with booking history, then change their IdP group and verify role reconciliation and legitimate contractor access according to the selected policy.

feature: SCIM 2.0 opt-in, verified SSO domain, resource discovery and token-scoped user provisioning
acceptance: Enable SCIM for one workspace, verify discovery and credential scope, create one eligible user and reject an unverified domain and requests when disabled.

feature: SCIM update, deactivate or reactivate, delete and preserve historical ownership
acceptance: Patch a provisioned member inactive, verify loss of workspace access with past bookings preserved, reactivate and finally delete the SCIM mapping.

feature: Enterprise IdP reauthentication and MFA behavior after account deactivation or active session expiry
acceptance: Qualify MFA, reauthentication, active session behavior and access revocation against an actual supported IdP and both client types.

feature: Responsive phone browser and home-screen Progressive Web App
acceptance: Use device browser and installed PWA to scan an asset, complete a permitted booking action and verify audit access and session persistence.

feature: Native Companion on iOS, iPadOS and Android using shared workspaces and roles
acceptance: With one account, switch the workspace on phone and tablet, compare records and permissions with Web and check tablet and landscape usability.

feature: Native camera scan, code claim, and iOS/Android deep link handoff
acceptance: Scan a known and unclaimed code from the camera and an incoming deep link, claim only in the allowed workspace and land on the correct record.

feature: Native asset detail/edit including photos, custom link fields and location changes
acceptance: Edit a field and photo and update a location on device, verify Web reads the same records, and repeat with a role that lacks the write grant.

feature: Native booking request, approval and fulfil/check-out or check-in flows
acceptance: Create and approve a request across Web and native app, then take a partial checkout and check-in on device and verify both clients agree.

feature: Native custody intake and return, including pooled quantity mutations
acceptance: Assign custody on Web and release selected units on device, verifying remaining custody and correct attribution across both clients.

feature: Native assigned-audit scan, findings, notes and photos on shared records
acceptance: Scan while signed in as an assigned auditor, attach evidence, then verify progress and findings appear in Web and deny an unassigned user.

feature: Registered private-server connection, cloud fallback selection and session isolation
acceptance: Connect to a registered self-hosted server, switch deliberately back to Cloud and verify credentials and cached records do not cross servers. Reject unregistered hosts.

feature: Plan-gated mobile push preferences and device registration
acceptance: Opt into notifications on an entitled workspace, verify delivery to the correct registered device, then opt out and verify subsequent notices are suppressed.

feature: Tagged authenticated Companion endpoints and common Web/Companion role policy
acceptance: Check typed clients with missing, expired and valid sessions and a changed workspace. Verify direct writes obey the same role policy.

feature: General-purpose Shelf public integration API, SDK, webhooks and third-party compatibility surface
acceptance: Record the provider's supported public contract if it exists, including endpoints, authentication, rate limits and versioning. Keep Companion and SCIM outside this compatibility claim.

feature: Self-hosted setup, sign-up and SSO toggles, mail and storage configuration
acceptance: Start an isolated instance, disable open registration, verify configuration gates and test storage plus email delivery before using the service as a reference.

feature: Contact owner and record found-item messages without a member session
acceptance: Submit a found-item message from an anonymous scan and verify routing to the intended workspace and minimal disclosure to the finder.

feature: Global command palette search across workspace-scoped assets, kits, locations and bookings
acceptance: Search by an overlapping term across entity types, verify navigation and withhold results for entities hidden from that role or workspace.

feature: Manage audit scope during permitted phases and capture start-time findings independently of live inventory edits
acceptance: Add and remove items when allowed, start the audit, then edit a live asset and verify the audit's starting evidence and tracked findings remain interpretable.

feature: Day/week/month calendar filtering and personal booking scope using a stable custodian identity
acceptance: Show one employee's calendar entries across supported views and deny private bookings or inaccessible custodian IDs despite a forged filter.

feature: Shelf uses workspace trees while independent site identities and stock-to-equipment commissioning belong to Warpdrive
acceptance: Reference the same stable site and bin from both domains, commission identified stock once, and reconcile one stock movement and one asset identity with linked history.
